description: Passive IDS capture points for CSLE level9 lateral movement experiments. These sensors preserve the original level9 topology and capture traffic for later Snort replay.

router_sensor.role: existing Snort IDS on the router path

passive_capture_sensors.reason: Captures attacker-to-Samba traffic on the target-side interface, especially SambaCry/SMB traffic to 15.9.2.3:445.
Captures Samba-to-DVWA lateral movement, especially 15.9.4.3 -> 15.9.4.74 SQL injection traffic.
Captures DVWA-to-Elasticsearch lateral movement, especially 15.9.5.74 -> 15.9.5.62 CVE-2015-1427 traffic.
Captures Elasticsearch lateral exposure and expert sequence traffic toward 15.9.6.7.
Captures Elasticsearch multi-homed exposure and post-CVE traffic on the 15.9.7 subnet.

notes: This first implementation is sidecar passive capture plus offline Snort replay, not an inline bridge.
It does not change the original CSLE level9 attack path or container topology.
It should be replaced by true OVS mirror sensors later if we need production-grade live IDS visibility.
